parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup vault
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the SAP HANA instance
parameters.name: hana_name

parameters.help_en: The private or internal IP address of the host where the primary node of the SAP HANA instance resides
parameters.help_zh: SAP HANA主节点的私有或内网IP地址
parameters.name: host

parameters.help_en: The instance number of the SAP HANA system
parameters.help_zh: 安装SAP HANA时指定的实例编号
parameters.name: instance_number

parameters.help_en: The username of the SYSTEMDB database
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en: The password that is used to connect with the SAP HANA database
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to connect with the SAP HANA database over Secure Sockets Layer (SSL)
parameters.help_zh: 打开SSL连接开关，表示使用SSL安全连接方式连接数据库
parameters.name: use_ssl

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to verify the SSL certificate of the SAP HANA database
parameters.help_zh: 打开验证SSL证书开关后，表示验证数据库服务端SSL证书
parameters.name: validate_certificate

parameters.help_en: The alert settings. Valid value: INHERITED, which indicates that the Cloud Backup client sends alert notifications by using the same method configured for the backup vault
parameters.help_zh: 告警设置。取值为INHERITED，表示使用与备份库一致的报警方式
parameters.name: alert_setting

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the ECS instances that host the SAP HANA instance to be registered. Cloud Backup installs backup clients on the specified ECS instances
parameters.help_zh: 要注册的HANA系统的所有节点（实例ID），备份服务将在这些节点中安装备份客户端
parameters.name: ecs_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The security identifier (SID) of the SAP HANA database. For more information, see How to find sid user and instance number of HANA db? (https://answers.sap.com/questions/555192/how-to-find-sid-user-and-instance-number-of-hana-d.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.55c34b4ftZeXNK)
parameters.help_zh:
SAP HANA数据库的SID。更多信息，请参见
如何查找SID (https://answers.sap.com/questions/555192/how-to-find-sid-user-and-instance-number-of-hana-d.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.55c34b4ftZeXNK)
parameters.name: sid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The backup type. Valid values:

SELF_ACCOUNT: Data is backed up within the same Alibaba Cloud account.
CROSS_ACCOUNT: Data is backed up across Alibaba Cloud accounts
parameters.help_zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持：
SELF_ACCOUNT：本账号备份
CROSS_ACCOUNT：跨账号备份
parameters.name: cross_account_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source Alibaba Cloud account that authorizes the current Alibaba Cloud account to back up data across Alibaba Cloud accounts
parameters.help_zh: 被当前账号管理的跨账号备份的原账号ID
parameters.name: cross_account_user_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) role that is created within the source Alibaba Cloud account and assigned to the current Alibaba Cloud account to authorize the current Alibaba Cloud account to back up data across Alibaba Cloud accounts
parameters.help_zh: 被当前账号管理的跨账号备份的原账号RAM中创建的角色名
parameters.name: cross_account_role_name

ClusterId.description_en: The ID of the SAP HANA instance

Code.description_en: The response code. The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful

Message.description_en: The returned message. If the request was successful, "successful" is returned. If the request failed, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功
false：失败
